name: Kingsway Corporation
summary: Kingsway Corporation through its subsidiaries, engages in the extended warranty and business services in the United States. It operates through two segments: Kingsway Search Xcelerator and Extended Warranty. The Extended Warranty segment markets, sells, and administers vehicle service agreements and related products for new and used automobiles, motorcycles, and ATVs.
